T½ — период полувыведения, «Действие» —: T½ — half-life; 'Action' — duration of effect (hours). Known medications are pre-filled with reference values (medpk.json); unknown ones — 8/12 h; everything is editable. The neural network uses these parameters: each drug's 'residual activity' and 'action window'. 'Intake schedule' (comma-separated, HH:MM) — a tray reminder balloon. The list is case-insensitive.
«Проверить модель» обучит НН с нуля на в: 'Check model' trains the NN from scratch on all records except the last N and validates on the held-out ones. MAE/RMSE is the honest accuracy (training loss hides it); permutation importance shows which features actually move the forecast.
Модель использует их как признаки «возра: The model uses them as 'age' (at each measurement) and 'sex' features; after a change the model retrains automatically.
Фичи: час дня (sin/cos), день недели (si: Features: hour of day (sin/cos), day of week (sin/cos), barometer, temperature, humidity, Kp, emotion, noise, sleep hours and quality, medication count + two PK features per drug: residual activity (T½ decay from each intake) and position in the action window. Changing the medication list retrains the model automatically.
